The '''Devon system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devon Four]], home to a religious sect that at one time refused to pay taxes to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which blockaded the planet in reprisal.<ref name="TCD" />
